build_HeadDepth: build a depth prediction head module that outputs normalized depth maps from feature tensors
build_HeadSeg: build a segmentation head module that predicts nclasses from feature tensors using conv layers
build_Interpolate: build an interpolation module that upscales tensors using bilinear interpolation with a scale factor
test_HeadDepth_forward: test the HeadDepth forward pass by passing a feature tensor and verifying sigmoid output
test_HeadSeg_forward: test the HeadSeg forward pass by passing a feature tensor and verifying nclasses output channels
